questions: Has the affected eye become more prominent or more open than usual recently?
Did this change begin suddenly, within the last few days?
Have you had any decrease or blurring of vision in that eye?
Have you had double vision?
Do you have significant eye pain, especially when moving the eye?
Is the eye red or unusually sensitive to light?
Have you had a severe headache, nausea, vomiting, weakness, numbness, or trouble speaking?
Have you recently injured the eye or head?
Have you had fever or swelling around the eye?
Are you unable to completely close that eye?
Does the eye feel dry, gritty, or as though something is in it?
Have you noticed reduced movement of that eye?
Is the other eye also becoming more prominent or more open?
Have you ever had a similar episode before?
Have you been diagnosed with thyroid disease?
Have you recently had symptoms of an overactive thyroid, such as weight loss, racing heartbeat, tremor, heat intolerance, or increased sweating?
Have you noticed a neck swelling?
Do you smoke or use nicotine products?
Have you recently started any new medication or stopped a thyroid medication?
Have you had recent eye surgery, injections, or procedures around the eye?
Have you had a recent sinus infection or severe nasal congestion?
Has the appearance of the eye been progressively worsening over weeks or months?
Have you noticed difficulty seeing colors with that eye?
Does covering either eye relieve double vision?
